leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure Zustand with the persist middleware to enable state persistence
Initialize a persisted Zustand store with custom storage options
Apply the persist middleware to manage state hydration and rehydration
Manipulate persisted state data across browser sessions
Integrate persisted Zustand state with Angular components
Control when and how state persistence occurs in your application
Update persisted state values and verify persistence behavior
